notes.title: AiDroneSim 1.37 : The most customizable FPV Sim Ever
notes.content:
AiDroneSim is now officially the most customizable FPV sim ever : import your images and 3D meshes in the in-game editor, and even import whole unreal engine maps !


[h1]PNG Import In Editor[/h1]
The custom Logo projector and the simple Custom Logo item now allow direct importing of PNG Files :
Import your Logo, or any PNG image, from the properties of the item : [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/0927edfa8363d3b8d41350f10f12a0ef262bb28d.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892636840]For more information, see the guide[/url]


[h1]3D Objects Import[/h1]
Direct import of 3d objects in editor from files. As with user PNGs, the files are saved as a copy, and will automatically be shared when you share a track or scenery including them. This also import the textures when possible.

Supported formats : OBJ and FBX (binary, embedded textures).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/1aef801f694eaac142a9a5b0507c29caf999f56c.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892636840]For more information, see the guide[/url]


[h1]Unreal Engine map import[/h1]

You can now fly any unreal engine map in AiDroneSim. This is an advanced feature, intended for power users. There is, for now, no in-game/steam workshop integrated way to share your map, but you can always send the zipped folder to friends. 

Here how to package your map for AiDroneSim in less than 10 minutes :

[previewyoutube=oMQyT8At_FY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=http://aidronesim.com/misc/metadata.zip]Don't forget to get the JSON metadata file template[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2892647571]See the complete guide[/url]

notes.title: 1.35 Update : Community & creators
notes.content:
First: if not already done, check the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1608560/view/3288214038338416067]current Open Contest[/url] with $800 prize pool.

[h1]Overview :[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Download[/b] Drones, Tracks & Sceneries directly from the game.
[*] [b]Undo/Redo[/b] (Ctrl+Z) system in the editor
[*] [b]Native objets editing[/b] in editor.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=LG6pHQx499c;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]General[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Download Drones, Tracks & Sceneries directly from the game.
[*] Hide/show all active user interface when flying with [H]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated scenic trail map : more space to go around, bigger gaps everywhere, in particular in the forests.
[*] Airplanes on cinematic mountain are now set to go to 70 kmh (from 60kmh)
[/list]
[*][h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] HUD settings are now available while flying, with direct effects.
[*] Improved FPS display.
[*] Tracks and sceneries are now always displayed in order : tracks first then sceneries, each in typographic order.
[/list]
[*][h3]Misc[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cinematic foliage settings now display foliage details up to 1.5x normal distance. Beware of performance issues !
[*] Low and medium foliage settings are now a bit more aggressive to reduce foliage details.
[*] USB controller input : improved performance. Can speed up FPS on some configurations where the CPU was the bottleneck.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed some issues with automatic false starts after spawning on some user tracks.
[*] Fixed some leaderboard display issues in the main menu.
[*] Fixed a rare bug that could cause crashes when spawning ghost quads while quitting the level.
[*] Fixed compatibility issues with [url=https://github.com/mikeneiderhauser/CRSFJoystick]CRSF Joystick[/url] . Thanks Felix.
[*] More sensitive axis detection on MacOS, fixing some controllers issues. ( flysky fs-i6x). Thanks Mark.
[/list]
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Undo/Redo System[/b]. ( Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y)
[*] [b]Editable Natives items[/b] : except for most trees, most native items on the map are now user editable. Delete, duplicate, move or resize any native item.
  Warning : With great power comes great responsibilities, natives items are often way less plug & play than the items available in the left panel. Don't forget to use Undo for any issue.
[*] [b]Groups[/b] :
  Group/ungroup selected items (CTRL+G, ALT+G).
  Grouped items will "stay together" even when not selected.
  Re-selecting an item later will select the whole group.
[*][b]Mass Selection[/b]
Double Click on an item to select all similar items currently in view.
[/list]
[h2]Quality Of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Ctrl+S[/b] to save current track.
[*] [b]Contextual Menu[/b] : right click on an item for easy access to common actions, such as group/ungroup.
[*] [b]SAVE & Fly[/b] from the editor, then BACK TO EDITOR for quick fight testing without going back to the main menu. (F2). The undo stack will still be available after flight-testing the map.
[*] FPS HUD are now available in the editor. While it does not map 1:1 to in-flight game performance, it's still an easy way to get an idea about performance.
[*] Camera Position & Speed are now saved in editor, for each track. Useful when alternating between editor mode and fly mode.
[*] Shortcuts are now displayed on most tooltips in the track editor.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved Editor UI : Left & Right panel are now resizable.
[*] Search box for the left panel.
[*] Huge performance improvements when flying on sceneries with huge amounts of objects (hi, Kéhops FPV !).
[*] In-Editor performance improvements on such sceneries.
[*] Faster saving time.
[*] Removed central control point on gizmo.
[/list]
[h3]Goodies[/h3]

  [list]
  [*] [b]Record a video[/b] flying on AiDroneSim.
  [*] [b]Post it publicly on youtube[/b], with Description as follow :
    [code] Entry for AiDroneSim 2022 Freestyle contest
    AiDroneSim Store page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/1608560/AI_Drone_Simulator/[/code]
  [*] [b]Send an email[/b] to contact@aidronesim.com with :

    [*] paypal associated email.
    [/list]

  [/list]

  [*] Edits and music are ok, but pick a [b]music with a sharable copyright[/b]. (no ads on Youtube ). There are great resources like : [url=https://ncs.io/]https://ncs.io/[/url]
  [*] Choose any map & any scenery you want.

  [*] [b]Minimum HD definition[/b]. (1920x1080)

notes.title: Update to 0.91
notes.content:
[h2]Version 0.91[/h2]

[h3][b]New[/b] : PIDs loop controls[/h3]
The game uses a unified model of rotation control and rotation physics. Each model has its values determined from the original BlackBox file.
But each pilot should have total control, so we introduced the [b]PID Authority[/b] and [b]PID Responsivity[/b] parameters :
[list]
[*] Increase [b]PID Authority[/b] to [b]kill the rebound[/b] after a flip. 
[*] Increase [b]PID Responsivity[/b] to have a [b]more responsive[/b] quad. (like more P)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40400118/e95ccce3ae44e8e943a13ec1d09ba9941d2efd28.png[/img]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added Field Of View shortcuts controls. By default, press the keyboard RIGHT key to increase the FOV, the LEFT key to decrease it.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed : track items not appearing after entering multiple times the Track Editor.
[*] Fixed : FrSky XSR-SIM compatibility. Now works fine.
